note: TEST_PLAN 4.1.5 / 4.1.8, prefill-side hip env arms. 'prefill': true makes --tier screen keep long32k (one request per server, prompt tok/s, same promote/drop thresholds as decode); 'edit' = 2K prompt + decode. long32k = ~32000 prompt tokens of src/**/*.cpp, read COLD (unique first line per request, so no prompt cache can help), max_tokens 32. It tests the rxr2 claim directly: AUTO_MAX = ceiling of the auto prefill chunk (preset 32768), +15% claimed at 32K on a 64 GB box with 24576. Run '--tier screen' first, then '--tier confirm --reps 2' on the promoted arms; add long64k for a context-scaling check on a winner. hcdown0 is the quality arm of 4.1.8: the preset has PF_HCDOWN=1 (rxr2: doubled first-token KL at 16K for +1.3% prompt); this arm measures the speed given up by turning it off, the KL comes from quality_gate.py on the 1-vs-0 pair. WMMA_GEMM and HCDOWN change the text (lossy: true); the text hash of long* cases is not compared (unique prefix), edit's is.
